items.title: Alicia Olatuja interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 9, 2018
items.q: you are one of the few people I’ve met who went from a Mozart opera to Dr. Lonnie Smith

ctx.x: But first I just want to say you are one of the few people I’ve met who went from a Mozart opera to Dr. Lonnie Smith. Does it seem like a leap or not?

Well I think I was exposed to soul music before I was doing Mozart. So in my brain it wasn’t a leap because all the music is always playing. But I would see how on a resume that might look a little interesting, yeah.
